notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, and the revised one draws the same disk, since the Ø37.5 bore already clears the Split Gear body by more than the slip clearance and takes no print fit (see 710-004_RotateCodeDisk.scad's header, which also gives the dimensions and the slot construction). Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
